exposure: duration of active phase of labor
outcome: successful vaginal birth after a previous cesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: A total of 340 pregnant females with a previous one cesarean section who underwent a trial of labor were enrolled.
finding: Successful vaginal birth after a cesarean occurred in 70.6% of females and was significantly associated with inter-pregnancy interval, cervical dilatation, cervical effacement, and duration of active phase of labor.
mod_finding: The study found that successful vaginal birth after a previous cesarean section was frequent (70.6%) and associated with specific obstetrical factors like inter-pregnancy interval and cervical parameters.
